info.title: Global Moto Rentals API
info.description: REST API for managing motorcycle rental listings, shops, brands, categories, and locations. Designed for MCP and AI Agent integration.

get.description: Get a paginated list of motorcycles with optional filters

parameters.name: countryCode
parameters.description: Filter by country code (e.g., TH, VN)

post.description: Create a new motorcycle listing (admin only)

get.description: Get a single motorcycle by ID

patch.description: Partially update a motorcycle (admin only). Returns 409 Conflict if attempting to overwrite non-daily or extension offers via legacy scalar or rate-tier fields.

get.description: Retrieve canonical structured Rental Offers (with nested Extension Charges and read-only dailyEquivalent) for a motorcycle

put.description: Atomically replace all Rental Offers and attached Extension Charges for a motorcycle, automatically projecting standalone unlabeled daily offers to legacy daily rate tiers (admin only)
Replace standalone daily rate tiers for daily-only motorcycles. Returns 409 Conflict if non-daily or extension offers exist on the motorcycle.

get.description: Get a paginated list of rental shops with optional filters

post.description: Create a new rental shop (admin only)

get.description: Get a single shop by ID

Conflict.description: Conflict with existing resource state (e.g. non-daily offers exist on motorcycle)

year_to.description: End model year for multi-year generation ranges (inclusive)

rental_offers.description: Hydrated canonical Rental Offers (including nested extensions and read-only dailyEquivalent)

year_to.description: End model year for multi-year generation ranges (inclusive)
End model year for multi-year generation ranges (inclusive)

dailyEquivalent.description: Read-only daily equivalent computed exclusively for fixed-day package_total offers (days > 1); null for calendar_month, hourly, daily, and extension offers.

motorcycle_rentals.description: Shop motorcycle fleet including hydrated rental_offers
